text:
Olivia: Quick heads-up: VIP guest (Acme corp) arriving ~30m with a wooden crate + small potted cactus, and a separate brown box marked 'GUITAR STAND - FRAGILE'. Can someone grab a badge + set a seat? They asked for a quiet corner. Parking space C4 reserved.
Sam: I'll meet them at the lobby — can we put them in the front of cafe table or CR-2? I vote CR-2 for quiet.
Diego: @Sam conference room 2 (CR-2) is booked until 4, but CR-B (near kitchen) is free. CR-B has a couch.
Front Desk: Badge process: host needs to fill sign-in form at front-desk tablet. I'll pre-print a yellow visitor sticker. Also, crate size? If it's big we'll need to store it behind the reception bench. Photo would help.
Maya: I can host — will sign them in. Can someone confirm the crate is not on pallet? don't want to block elevator.
Sam: Crate is about 3'x2', not palletized per vendor note. Photo: https://imgur.com/abcd123 (photo of crate, cactus perched).
Front Desk: Thanks @Sam — looks ok. We'll bring a flat dolly. Crate can sit by locker L12 for now. Badge color = yellow sticker; temporary code for door = 7342. Please don't share widely.
Mailroom Bot: Package scan: 'GUITAR STAND' box scanned 2145678910 -> placed at L19 (lobby shelf). Fragile flag set.
Diego: Can someone label the crate 'Acme - demo' and leave 'Fragile - cactus' sticker? I'll do it in 5.
Maya: Got it. I'll drop by front desk in 8.
Olivia: Legendary. TY! Also FYI: if the guest asks about snacks, point to the bottom shelf fridge (help-yourself). :coffee: 
Front Desk: Guest checked in at 4:05pm. Badge printed. Crate moved to L12. Dolly returned. @Maya we'll walk them up.
Mailroom Bot: Final: All items logged. Delivery note #2145678910. Thread closed.
